def forward_once(self, x):
        h = (x-self.mean)/self.std
        h = self.stage1(h)
        h_relu1_2 = h
        h = self.stage2(h)
        h_relu2_2 = h
        h = self.stage3(h)
        h_relu3_3 = h
        h = self.stage4(h)
        h_relu4_3 = h
        h = self.stage5(h)
        h_relu5_3 = h
        return [x,h_relu1_2, h_relu2_2, h_relu3_3, h_relu4_3, h_relu5_3]
